item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
## BermudaPay 1.1.0
### New features
- **Flexible pay frequencies** — weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, or monthly pay periods. The tax annualization follows the matching official OTC calculator variant (52/26/24/12 periods per year), configurable in Settings → Employee → Pay Schedule. - **Annual salary support** — a rate change can now switch an employee to an annual salary. Salary accrues per period and is prorated by calendar day across a mid-period switch from hourly, so a change taking effect mid-period produces a correct split payslip. - **Actual payments & reconciliation** — record the amount actually transferred for each period on the payslip. The new reconciliation panel (shown on the latest payslip) compares, per fiscal year, the payroll tax due under the official formula against what was actually withheld, plus recorded transfers against computed net pay, and suggests a single correction to apply to the next payment as an adjustment line. - **Per-fiscal-year tax rules** — tax configurations are now effective-dated. Each period is taxed under the rules in force on its end date, so historical fiscal years keep their own bands when rates change in April. Existing databases migrate automatically: prior bands are preserved for historical dates and the official FY26-27 bands apply from 1 April 2026. - **Adjustments** — payslips can carry non-taxed corrections (positive or negative) with full visibility in the payslip view, PDF export, and CSV export.
### Improvements
- PDF payslips show salary and adjustment lines; CSV export gains Salary Pay, Adjustments, and Actual Paid columns. - New periods start the day after the previous period ends, supporting variable-length (monthly/semi-monthly) cadences.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
## BermudaPay 1.2.0
### New features
- **Quarterly Tax Returns (PR1)** — the app now auto-completes the quarterly payroll-tax filing figures. Open **File → Quarterly Tax Returns…** (⌘⇧T) to pick any fiscal quarter and see, computed straight from your recorded periods: gross taxable remuneration paid in the quarter (grouped by pay date, matching the official basis), the employee portion actually withheld, the employer portion at your configured rate, the total payable, the filing due date, and the band table mirroring the official OTC calculator's Quarter Output (PR1) schedule — including the above-cap count. Export a worksheet PDF to transfer onto the E-Tax submission. - An optional **Payroll Tax Account No.** field in Settings → Employee is printed on the worksheet.
### Correctness & data safety
- **Periods per year is now tracked per fiscal year.** Setting 27 (bi-weekly) or 53 (weekly) for a year with an extra pay day no longer recomputes prior years' salary accrual, tax, or reconciliation — earlier years are pinned automatically, visible and editable in Settings → Pay Schedule. - Tax-rule effective dates are timezone-proof: configurations entered as "1 April" take effect 1 April regardless of local time, and historical payslips display their own year's rates. - An unreadable database file can no longer be silently overwritten: the app explains the problem, keeps a rolling backup alongside the data file, and recovery via File → Import preserves that backup. - Year-to-date figures now mean the same thing everywhere (fiscal-year-to-date) across the payslip, PDF, sidebar, and CSV export. - The PR1 band table classifies zero-earnings quarters correctly, payslip PDFs paginate instead of overflowing, batch exports keep every page, withheld tax locks only once a period's pay day has passed, and the reconciliation correction can't be applied to an already-paid period.
### Design refresh
- Paid / variance / finalized badges on payslips and sidebar rows, a segmented Payslip ⇄ Timesheet switcher, clearer reconciliation states (green when settled; red = employee owes, orange = employee is owed), modern grouped Settings, and tidier editors throughout.

item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.description:
## BermudaPay 1.2.1
### New feature
- **Overtime for salaried employees.** A salaried rate entry now carries an hourly overtime rate (Settings → Rates). Hours beyond the daily overtime threshold **or** beyond the new weekly threshold (Settings → Employee → Work Pattern, default 45 hours) are paid at that rate on top of the salary — whichever rule yields more each week, so a sixth working day counts even when no single day runs long, with no double counting. Overtime appears on the payslip, PDF, and CSV as before and is taxed as recurring earnings. - The timesheet summary now shows paid Regular/OT hours straight from the calculation engine (matching the payslip exactly, including weekly overtime) alongside total recorded hours.
### Notes
- Hourly employees are unaffected: their overtime remains hours beyond the daily threshold, exactly as before — historical payslips do not change. - After updating, check the overtime rate on your salaried rate entry (Settings → Rates): it carries over the rate from the prior hourly entry until you set the new one.

item.title: Version 1.2.2
item.description:
## BermudaPay 1.2.2
### Bug fix
- **Insurance proration no longer loses a day across a mid-period rate change.** Rate entries whose effective date was created with an earlier version's date picker could carry a hidden time-of-day, causing the segment day-counter to prorate a 14-day period as 13/14ths — understating social and health insurance on the period straddling the change (e.g. SI $69.92 instead of $75.30). Day counting is now calendar-day based, segment boundaries snap to midnight, and the rate editor normalizes effective dates on save. Affected periods recompute correctly after updating; locked tax amounts are unchanged.
